kultivator.voice.credits.8: VOICEVOX:ずんだもん, VOICEVOX:雨晴はう, VOICEVOX:もち子さん — townsfolk chatter and town crowds (with the voices above)
kultivator.voice.setting.obrolan.tip: Short quiet Japanese murmurs when two townsfolk talk (a man, woman, old man, old woman or child by their looks), fading with distance. The "Voice/Speech" slider applies too; only plays with "Spoken voices: All".
kultivator.voice.setting.riuh.tip: Background crowd in inhabited places (the capital, themed cities, towns, villages, sect compounds): bargaining in the market, cups and laughter in taverns, waves and gulls in harbours, footsteps in the streets, bells and chanting in temples. The more townsfolk near you, the livelier; quieter at night, in the rain and indoors. The "Ambient/Environment" slider applies too.
